To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of the Internet has a positive impact on the quality of the relationship between a firm and its customers; (2) this impact is mediated by the use of the Web for communication and by the use of Web-based technologies; (3) the effect of the Internet on customer relationship quality is moderated by the firm's Internet experience and by the firm's customer relationship quality orientation.

the development and implementation of an integrated index of quality of storage management in hospital entities.
the development of an index for measuring the efficiency of warehouse management in hospitals.
the evaluation of the performance of hospital warehouses.

the application of a comprehensive and integral quality index for the management of warehouses allowed to evaluate the process in an integral manner, to increase the internal control, to improve the logistic system supply in an active way and to increase the level of service to the client.

the implementation of the integral index of warehouse management quality, allowed the systematic evaluation of the process, the increase in internal control, the effectiveness of the logistic system supply, and the increase of the level of service to the client.

the application of the index of quality management of the warehouses allowed to identify the nature of the causes of problems of the services of the warehouses, at the same time facilitating the establishment of a level of management as a basis for the perfection of the process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the combination of two well known techniques, Pareto and Cause-and-Effect, with an integral quality index can help to identify and prioritize the causes that affect the quality of a warehouse process, and that the application of this index can help to increase the control of this process and improve the service level to the client.
the use of the index allowed the identification of the causes of the problems in the warehouse services, as well as the establishment of a level of management to improve the warehouse process.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the integral index of quality management of warehouses, applied to hospitals, allows the identification of the main causes that affect the quality of the service and provides a basis for the improvement of the process.

the quality of the storage management in a hospital is not only related to the quality of the products, but to other factors, such as the quality of the service provided to the client and the quality of the human resource.

the integral quality index of the warehouse management allows to evaluate the process, the increase of internal control, the effectiveness of the logistics system and the increment of the client service level.
